import MumfordLib.BarycentricSubdivisionChainMap
import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivisionNaturality
import Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.Homotopy

/-!
# The barycentric subdivision homotopy on vertex lists

Cone the difference between a simplex and its subdivision, corrected by the
homotopy on its boundary, from the first vertex. The resulting natural chain
homotopy compares the identity with barycentric subdivision.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {m k n : ℕ}

/-- The degree-raising operator for the subdivision homotopy. -/
def barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap (m : ℕ) :
    (n : ℕ) →
      (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).X n ⟶
        (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).X (n + 1) :=
  Nat.rec (motive := fun n ↦
    (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).X n ⟶
      (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).X (n + 1))
    0 (fun n f ↦ Sigma.desc fun v ↦
      (vertexListChain v - vertexListChain v ≫ barycentricSubdivision m (n + 1) -
        vertexListChain v ≫
          (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).d (n + 1) n ≫ f) ≫
        vertexListCone (v 0) (n + 1))

@[simp]
theorem barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap_zero (m : ℕ) :
    barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap m 0 = 0 := rfl

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem vertexListChain_barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap_succ
    (v : Fin (n + 2) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) :
    vertexListChain v ≫ barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap m (n + 1) =
      (vertexListChain v - vertexListChain v ≫ barycentricSubdivision m (n + 1) -
        vertexListChain v ≫
          (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).d (n + 1) n ≫
          barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap m n) ≫ vertexListCone (v 0) (n + 1) :=
  Sigma.ι_desc _ _

/-- The positive-degree boundary equation for the subdivision homotopy. -/
theorem barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap_boundary (m n : ℕ) :
    barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap m (n + 1) ≫
        (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).d (n + 2) (n + 1) =
      𝟙 _ - barycentricSubdivision m (n + 1) -
        (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).d (n + 1) n ≫
          barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap m n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
      intro v
      dsimp only [vertexListSSet] at v
      change vertexListChain v ≫ _ = vertexListChain v ≫ _
      rw [vertexListChain_barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap_succ_assoc,
        vertexListCone_boundary]
      simp only [barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap_zero, comp_zero, sub_zero,
        Preadditive.comp_sub, Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.comp_id, Category.assoc]
      rw [← Category.assoc (barycentricSubdivision m 1), barycentricSubdivision_comm]
      change _ = vertexListChain v - vertexListChain v ≫ barycentricSubdivision m 1
      simp only [show barycentricSubdivision m 0 = 𝟙 _ from rfl, Category.comp_id]
      abel
  | succ n ih =>
      apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
      intro v
      dsimp only [vertexListSSet] at v
      change vertexListChain v ≫ _ = vertexListChain v ≫ _
      rw [vertexListChain_barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap_succ_assoc,
        vertexListCone_boundary]
      simp only [Preadditive.comp_sub, Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.comp_id,
        Category.assoc]
      rw [← Category.assoc (barycentricSubdivision m (n + 2)), barycentricSubdivision_comm]
      rw [← Category.assoc (barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap m (n + 1)), ih]
      simp only [Preadditive.comp_sub, Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.id_comp, Category.assoc]
      rw [← Category.assoc
        ((VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).d (n + 2) (n + 1))
        ((VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).d (n + 1) n),
        (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).d_comp_d]
      simp only [zero_comp, comp_zero, sub_zero]
      abel

/-- The subdivision homotopy commutes with affine maps of standard simplices. -/
theorem barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap_naturality
    (w : Fin (m + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 1))) (n : ℕ) :
    barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap m n ≫
        (vertexListChainMap (affineSimplexMap w)).f (n + 1) =
      (vertexListChainMap (affineSimplexMap w)).f n ≫
        barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap k n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
      intro v
      dsimp only [vertexListSSet] at v
      change vertexListChain v ≫ _ = vertexListChain v ≫ _
      rw [vertexListChain_barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap_succ_assoc,
        vertexListCone_map]
      simp only [Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.assoc]
      rw [← Category.assoc (barycentricSubdivision m (n + 1)),
        barycentricSubdivision_naturality]
      rw [← Category.assoc (barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap m n), ih]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
      rw [← (vertexListChainMap (affineSimplexMap w)).comm_assoc]
      simp only [vertexListChain_map_assoc,
        vertexListChain_barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap_succ,
        Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.assoc]
      rfl

/-- The identity is chain homotopic to barycentric subdivision on vertex lists. -/
def barycentricSubdivisionHomotopy (m : ℕ) :
    Homotopy (𝟙 (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))))
      (barycentricSubdivisionChainMap m) where
  hom i j := if h : i + 1 = j then
      barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap m i ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).X h)
    else 0
  zero i j h := by
    simp only [ComplexShape.down_Rel] at h
    exact dif_neg h
  comm i := by
    cases i with
    | zero =>
        rw [HomologicalComplex.id_f, Homotopy.dNext_zero_chainComplex,
          Homotopy.prevD_chainComplex]
        change 𝟙 _ = 0 + (barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap m 0 ≫ 𝟙 _) ≫
          (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).d 1 0 +
          barycentricSubdivision m 0
        simp only [barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap_zero, zero_comp, zero_add]
        rfl
    | succ n =>
        simp only [HomologicalComplex.id_f, Homotopy.dNext_succ_chainComplex,
          Homotopy.prevD_chainComplex, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id]
        change 𝟙 _ =
          (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).d (n + 1) n ≫
              barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap m n +
            barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap m (n + 1) ≫
              (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).d (n + 2) (n + 1) +
            barycentricSubdivision m (n + 1)
        rw [barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap_boundary]
        abel

end Mumford.Analytic
